workspace.text:
Hi Brad. I've checked Priya's and Marcus's calendars. Here are the 30-minute slots where they are both available next week:

Mon: 09:00, 09:30
Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
Wed: 15:00, 15:30

Fri: 11:00, 11:30

Let me know which of these works for Elena and David.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text: Hi Alison. I've checked Elena's and David's calendars. The only time that works for all four partners is Thursday at 14:30. Please go ahead and book it.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Great, I've booked Thursday at 14:30. Over to you to send the confirmation email.
